rationale: The candidate is a coherent single mass in all four views, so it avoids view-to-view collision and fragmentation. The non-rectangular footprint is a plus, and the volume has a readable compactness with some top/bottom differentiation. However, the form remains essentially a sealed faceted block sitting within the parcel; the blue access edge is not answered by any legible court, notch, seam, or undercut, so the required active ground threshold is missing. The silhouette is acceptable as an early massing object, but the section does not yet express neighborhood-living program logic: there is no clear public void or terrace, no active edge condition, and the upper mass does not meaningfully protect a more open ground relation. As a result, program fit fails on semantic grounds even though the geometry is internally coherent.
